districts.name: Interleaved Bookends
districts.idea: Balanced three-floor combs, with open cantilever bays, flush exterior spine faces, and alternating ramp lanes. A fallen comb becomes a bridge with upright cover.

districts.name: Branch Mesa Forest
districts.idea: Three broad branches per crown, supported by separate legs. Multiple stacked crowns form shaded courts and elevated forks. One approach flight per crown avoids neighboring legs.

districts.name: Broken-Ring Canyon
districts.idea: Rotating C terraces around open atria. Fixed corner supports and exterior flights preserve the void; bridges attach to clear side galleries rather than solid corner piers.

districts.name: Folded Ribbon Gorge
districts.idea: Rigid folded plates form ridges, gullies and covered spaces. Slender loose links cross between crests. Removing a support changes the slope and the routes beneath it.

districts.name: Reciprocal Crown Bazaar
districts.idea: Eight mutually bearing beams per crown, plus internal mezzanine rings on inward pier landings. The exterior climb faces remain clear. No glued joints or magnetic stabilization.

districts.name: Skyrail Shipyard
districts.idea: Two-deck rigid trusses with a central upper-deck opening for the rising internal flight. Separate piers and loose cross-links turn falling corridors into covered ramps.

districts.name: Domino Portal Quarter
districts.idea: Tall portal pages with open frames, alternating front/back ramp lanes, and H-shaped street junctions. Shared junction bodies avoid overlapping independent bridge branches.

districts.name: Keystone Vault District
districts.idea: Five-piece compression arches with flared bearing feet, movable tied thrust cradles and raised keystone seats. The deck loads the keystone so removing it produces a real failure.

districts.name: Rolling Borough
districts.idea: Hollow octagonal drums with two internal floors, faceted shells and loose cradles. A moved cradle lets a drum tip; lateral impacts can change which surfaces act as floors.

districts.name: Counterweight Sky Harbor
districts.idea: Eight bascule leaves hinged to dynamic frames, loose heel weights and lower landing blocks. Separated rear stair lanes reach the leaves; removing a weight lets gravity lower the nose.
